notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v1.0.1
notes.content:
1.0.1
- Fixed missing collisions in Chicago
- Fixed Tutorial 2 failing too easily
- Fixed missing twist value in panels for remote boats
- Fixed F50 showing wrong foil type in Setup Screen
- Fixed F50 GBR different font colors on wing
- Fixed F50 FRA font size on wing
- Fixed Bermuda location having 0% salinity
- Water rendering tweaks and performance improvements
- Fixed F50 18m wing not in the water when capsized
- Added full HUD colors customization via config file hud_settings.kl

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v0.8.1 - OCS hot fix
notes.content:
0.8.1
- Fixed no OCS detection
- Added support for single line comments in Koala
    ex: boat=jx50 // boat to use

tags.feature: - Added support for single line comments in Koala

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation v0.8 - Bermuda
notes.content:
0.8.0
- Added Bermuda location
- New timeline crossing system to avoid missing crossings online
    due to unstable connections
- Look left/right on Jx40 uses the corresponding cameras for better visibility
- Fixed viscous drag becoming too big when submerged lengths approach 0
- Fixed and improved Jx40 default skins
- Increased base foil drag on all boats rewarding players flying higher

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation 0.7.3
notes.content:
0.7.3
- Added Connection Quality indicator in drivable cameras
- Tutorial failure also resets crew position
- Only show "spectate" button if server has spectator slots set
- Fixed Force Feedback pushing when menu screens are visible
- Limited server names to 26 chars
- Better handling of long player names
- Fixed flickering "Hydrofoil Generation" on Den Haag Pier
- Tutorial 5 more lenient on TWA, now allows up to TWA 70°
- Improved Tutorial fail message when failing because of TWA
    shows limits
- HUD color can now be switched with CTRL+H

notes.title: Hydrofoil Generation 0.7.2
notes.content:
0.7.2
- Relaxed tack detection logic making Tutorial 4 & 5 too hard
- Wing camber inversion uses projected TWA only when above 10kn
    avoids wing "flapping" at race start
- Fixed occasional server crash on invalid foil control input
- Fixed "foil speed sensitivity" slider erroneously modified when
    when clicking "edit boat controls"
